title: IHC Staining of Iba1 and GFAP Using DAB
author: Hanne HD Dhondt
materials: Streptavidin/HRP antibody (Dako; P0397 OR Invitrogen; S911) is diluted 1:1000 in PBS-T. Example: 6.5 ml: 6.5 µl STR-HRP + 6500 µl PBS-T 0.1%

!! work in the hood during the whole DAB step!! Wear double gloves and an extra pair of covering sleeves. Take with you: 25 mL PBS pH 7.6 in a 50 ml falcon covered with aluminium foil. PBS-T to rinse 1 tablet of 10 mg 3,3'-Diaminobenzidine tetrahydrochloride (DAB) (Sigmaaldrich; D5905; CAS: 7411-49-6) An Eppendorf tube with H 2 O 2 (you need 7 µl) 0.22 µm filter (Carl Roth; SE2M035I07) 10 ml syringe Plastic bag Extra prepared plates with the same label as the ones you are using now.

Cover with #1.5 cover slips (epredia; BB02400500SC13MNZ0) by using DPX (Sigma-Aldrich; 06522; CAS: 84-74-2). To put DPX use a Pasteur pipet as a “spoon” since the solution is very viscous. Let them dry Overnight in the hood.

!! work in the hood during the whole DAB step!! Wear double gloves and an extra pair of covering sleeves. Take with you: 25 mL PBS pH 7.6 in a 50 ml falcon covered with aluminium foil. PBS-T to rinse 1 tablet of 10 mg 3,3'-Diaminobenzidine tetrahydrochloride (DAB) (Sigmaaldrich; D5905; CAS: 7411-49-6) An Eppendorf tube with H 2 O 2 (you need 7 µl) 0.22 µm filter (Carl Roth; SE2M035I07) 10 ml syringe Plastic bag Extra prepared plates with the same label as the ones you are using now.

steps.title: Add citrate buffer and heat
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 1 M citrate buffer (pH 6) to each well, ensuring the tissue lies flat and contacts the buffer. Incubate 30 min at 80 °C, then place on ice for 20 min in the same buffer.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Prepare a solution of 3 % H₂O₂ (Chemlab; CL00.2306.1000; CAS 7722‑84‑1) plus 10 % MeOH (VWR; 20846.361; CAS 67‑65‑1) in PBS (example: 5.6 mL PBS + 0.7 mL 30 % H₂O₂ + 0.7 mL 100 % MeOH). Add 500 µL of this mixture to each well and incubate 10 min at room temperature on a wobbler.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: For Iba1: dilute antibody 1:500 (Abcam; Ab5076; RRID AB_2224402) in PBS containing 10 % rabbit serum (Dako; X0902). For GFAP: dilute antibody 1:2000 (Dako; z0334; RRID AB_10013382) in PBS containing 10 % goat serum (Dako; X0907). Add 250 µL per well and incubate overnight at room temperature.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Iba1: add rabbit anti‑goat biotinylated antibody 1:600 (Dako; E0466) in PBS‑T. GFAP: add goat anti‑rabbit biotinylated antibody 1:600 (Abcam; ab6720; RRID AB_954902) in PBS‑T. Add 250 µL per well and incubate 30 min at room temperature on a wobbler.

steps.title: Avidin/streptavidin incubation
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL per well of the (unspecified) avidin/streptavidin solution and incubate 30 min at room temperature on a wobbler.

steps.title: Prepare DAB substrate
steps.instruction: Dissolve one DAB tablet in 25 mL PBS, cover the tube with aluminium foil, filter the solution through a 0.22 µm filter using a 10 mL syringe, and finally add 7 µL H₂O₂ to the filtered DAB solution.

steps.title: DAB development
steps.instruction: Remove PBS‑T from the wells, add 250 µL of the prepared DAB solution per well, and develop at room temperature: for Iba1, allow 6 min after pipetting the first well; for GFAP, allow 3 min after all 24 wells have been pipetted.

steps.title: Wash and transfer sections
steps.instruction: Fill a new plate with PBS, move the sections to the new plate, rinse the sections with a 1:1 mixture of PBS and AD in a petri dish, then rinse with PBS (Gibco; 21600‑096).

steps.title: Dehydrate sections
steps.instruction: Incubate sequentially: 5 min 70 % EtOH (Fisher Scientific; E/0650DF/08; CAS 64‑17‑5), 5 min 90 % EtOH, 5 min 100 % EtOH, another 5 min 100 % EtOH, and finally 5 min Histoclear II (Agar Scientific; A2‑0105; CAS 64742‑48‑9; CAS 5989‑27‑5).

steps.title: Mount slides
steps.instruction: Mount the sections on pork gelatin‑coated glass slides and let them dry overnight.

steps.title: Image slides
steps.instruction: Visualise the slides with a Leica Aperio CS2 slide scanner at 20× magnification.
